title: Inventory and hash 56 exports and combine 10858 rows
acceptance_criterion: Reproducible source manifest and row count
notes: Counts are provisional

title: Build provisional 6822 unique records and 6592 record screening queue
acceptance_criterion: Preserve hints as unscreened and retain all queue IDs
notes: Zero human inclusion decisions

title: Recover verified execution date and timezone for 25 exported searches
acceptance_criterion: Timestamp or explicit unresolved reason for each search ID
notes: Never infer dates from file timestamps

title: Reconcile 23 missing on-screen hit counts with export counts
automation_allowed: Compare logged hits with file rows
acceptance_criterion: Verified screen count or explicit unresolved reason per ID
notes: Export rows are not automatically screen hits

title: Explain Scopus 1061 versus 1050 and 107 versus 105
automation_allowed: Compare original screen and export counts
acceptance_criterion: Document explanation and whether any records were missed
notes: Original platform history may be needed

title: Check possible IEEE I1_HRC 1000 record cap and ACM search total
acceptance_criterion: Document coverage and decision on split or rerun
notes: Any new search gets a new version

title: Decide whether planned Scopus S3_HRC must be run
acceptance_criterion: Document run or no-run decision and rationale
notes: No S3_HRC export currently exists

title: Adjudicate five same-title conflicting-DOI groups
acceptance_criterion: Preserve original records and manual reason per group
notes: Do not auto-merge conflicting DOIs

title: Resolve nine of 43 priority references without DOI linkage
acceptance_criterion: Record manual match or unresolved reason for all nine
notes: Priority references are not auto-included

title: Work through 3034 missing abstracts in documented stages
automation_allowed: Candidate metadata retrieval by DOI or PMID
acceptance_criterion: Record source and failure reason with remaining count
notes: Missing abstract is not an exclusion

title: Freeze four RQs PCC source types AI policy field tiers and reliability plan
acceptance_criterion: Signed protocol with reliability targets and amendments before formal screening
notes: Scope changes require amendment

title: Confirm funding and name trained paid non-author reviewers and adjudication role
acceptance_criterion: Distinct reviewers; training competency check; hours budget and named adjudication role
notes: Source adjudicators are Nam and Staley; additional separate adjudicator is optional; assignments remain unconfirmed

title: Register protocol and search-change plan as specified by PI
acceptance_criterion: Registration URL and version freezing RQs eligibility coder design reliability thresholds AI policy and analysis
notes: Do not claim registration before it occurs

title: Train on mixed examples then calibrate on two fresh random 25-record rounds
automation_allowed: Validate input fields and tally disagreements
acceptance_criterion: Original decisions; agreement >=85 percent and AC1 >=0.80; kappa; resolved error patterns; codebook v1
notes: 93-record legacy pilot manifest is training pool; repeat with fresh rounds if project targets are unmet

title: Dual-screen all 6592 records in the shared queue
automation_allowed: Packet validation and weekly completion counts
acceptance_criterion: Two original judgments plus consensus and reasons for every ID
notes: Recalculate dates using pilot speed

title: Retrieve and independently assess all advanced reports
automation_allowed: Track retrieval attempts and missing reports
acceptance_criterion: 10-15-report calibration with agreement >=90 percent and AC1 >=0.80 then full dual review and exclusion reasons
notes: Source project targets need sign-off; timeline depends on advanced-report volume

title: Link multiple reports to study_id while retaining report_id
automation_allowed: Candidate links from DOI PMID and title
acceptance_criterion: Human-verified study-to-report crosswalk
notes: Do not count reports as independent studies

title: Extract function changed work condition and exposure unit
automation_allowed: Check required columns and source locators
acceptance_criterion: Two extractions plus agreed RQ1 evidence with locators
notes: RQ1 hints are not included-study counts

title: Extract exposure definition measure source time window and validity
acceptance_criterion: Two extractions plus agreed RQ2 evidence with locators
notes: Separate exposure from outcome measures

title: Independently code RQ3a proposed measured and tested pathways
acceptance_criterion: Two original core codes plus agreed RQ3a fields; organizational pathways and temporal order retained
notes: RQ3 pathway query not separately exported

title: Independently code RQ3b OSH outcomes support estimates confounders and gaps
acceptance_criterion: Two original core codes plus agreed RQ3b fields linking outcomes and exposure without inferring an unmeasured pathway
notes: OSH proxy and injury are distinct

title: Independently code current RQ4 controls and human evaluation levels
acceptance_criterion: Agreed RQ4 core empirical control evidence states response or OSH outcomes; background proposals separate
notes: A proposed control is not a demonstrated effect

title: Build function-to-exposure and measurement matrices
acceptance_criterion: Study-level denominators and full-text-verified tables
notes: Do not double-count multiple reports

title: Build integrated RQ3 pathway-outcome-design support and gap map
acceptance_criterion: Tables distinguish proposed/tested pathways and association/causation
notes: Meta-analysis requires separate compatibility assessment

title: Map control evaluation levels and later experimental variables
acceptance_criterion: Separate field worker-OSH evidence from future hypotheses
notes: Do not call simulation prevention evidence

title: Compare adjacent reviews and prepare PRISMA-ScR and PRISMA-S reporting
automation_allowed: Aggregate only approved record report and study codes
acceptance_criterion: Verified flow search table reliability table measurement framework adjacent-review comparison and draft
notes: Count Chen 167-paper review once

title: PRESS review of final queries and document inaccessible coverage
acceptance_criterion: Independent PRESS comments responses final query version and decision on PsycINFO and ACM
notes: Final or update searches follow peer review; current exports are discovery retrieval

title: Create disjoint random 25-record calibration rounds separate from mixed training pool
automation_allowed: Seeded random selection IDs and source hash
acceptance_criterion: 50 unique IDs split into two 25-record rounds with recorded seed and source hash
notes: Prepared ID manifest is not completed screening or reliability results

title: Report pre-consensus stage and core-field reliability with recoding history
automation_allowed: Deterministic statistics from locked human codes
acceptance_criterion: Agreement kappa AC1 or AC2 alpha and CIs as prespecified; independent originals and field recoding log
notes: Primary-statistic choice is frozen before results; no values from blank decisions

title: Develop operational exposure measurement framework and later Delphi-experiment priorities
acceptance_criterion: Source-linked metrics units dose time windows reversibility feasibility validation gaps and follow-on priorities
notes: Paper 2 Delphi and Paper 3-5 experiments remain future proposals
